_comment: Permanent URL registry. fixes: bad URL → known correct replacement applied on every validation run. skip: URLs known to be dead/wrong with no reliable fix — validator records them without spending an HTTP request.

https://windsurf.com.reason: windsurf.com acquired by Cognition — redirects to devin.ai/desktop

https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai.reason: cloud.google.com/vertex-ai redirects to Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform; /docs is the correct Vertex AI entry point

https://www.jetbrains.com/ai/.reason: jetbrains.com/ai/ now redirects to JetBrains Air (a different product); /ai-assistant/ is the correct AI Assistant page

https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/.reason: OpenAI migrated docs — keep checking for a stable redirect target

https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/micr.reason: generator pointed to a OneNote Notebooks support page instead of the Microsoft 365 Copilot product page

skip.https://www.tabnine.com: acquired by Tricentis — tabnine.com redirects to tricentis.com; no Tabnine-specific page remains
skip.https://lumalabs.ai/dream-machine: redirects to lumalabs.ai/app — the app IS Dream Machine; treat as valid
skip.https://www.canva.com/ai-image-generator: returns Unsupported client error to bots; URL is correct, skip validation
skip.https://azure.microsoft.com/products/ai-: Azure blocks scrapers (unreachable to validator); URL is correct
skip.https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/produc: Azure blocks scrapers (unreachable to validator); URL is correct
skip.https://www.grammarly.com/: Grammarly blocks scrapers (unreachable to validator); URL is correct
skip.https://siliconflow.cn: Chinese domain — may be unreachable outside China; URL is correct
skip.https://stability.ai/stable-image: Stability AI page is valid but excerpt shows only CSS; URL is correct for Stable Diffusion product
